text: also, adding in a number to the output png would be ideal, so that a prompt for filling it can be like a color by number and not just guessing. lastly, i have found that gpt-2-image is compeltely blind to our uv output for some reason, so it just generates something compleetely random beacuse it must think its a blank reference image. i found out by doing a small A/B test where in gimp i added a layer of pink fill over everything with an opacity of 6% and t hen sent that and it finally started to actually generate within the provided image
resolution: Added a separate image-generation UV export without weakening the transparent wireframe. uv-ai-guide.png uses the same quad-aware authored edges, an exact 6%-alpha pink full-canvas signal from the user's successful A/B test, and one high-contrast bitmap number per visible exact texture footprint; already-stacked logical islands share one number. AI GUIDE is available in the toolbar, Texture Atlas context menu, and prestack + AI Guide action, with atomic package persistence and copied path. Raster, footprint deduplication, store, menu, bridge bundles, and the ReleaseFast editor build pass.
